stories.headline: Kalshi in Talks to Raise Funding at $65 Billion Valuation
stories.body: Kalshi is in talks to raise money at a $65 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported Thursday (Nov. 12). That’s 62.5% above the $40 billion valuation Kalshi secured in late October, when it announced a $1 billion round that had been expected to be its last before an initial public offering. stories.headline: Exclusive research: Citi is redesigning 100 processes. What’s stopping others?
stories.body: Only 13% of banking professionals say that their institutions most often redesign workflows end to end when adopting AI, according to the latest survey by American Banker’s Market Intelligence team. Why is it so difficult?
